module: Flowgraph node "Flow Button" (simple type, category logic, tag input). A button in the node: a click (only while the graph is running) produces a one-frame pulse on the flow output. Input: flow. The button label (data.btnName, "Push" by default) takes the name of the linked pin (or the target node name if the pin is named flow).

drawMiddle.desc: Editor: draws the button; a click arms doTrigger if the graph is in the "running" state.

work.desc: Sets the flow output to doTrigger then resets it to false.

onLink.desc: Editor hook: renames the button after the pin or target node if the name is still "Push".

onUnlink.desc: Editor hook: resets the label to "Push".
